invariant: Every input from outside the device that can change a direct session's state is authenticated by a secret the peer's rotation replaces. An input that is not is listed as an exception or as outside the model, with the reason it cannot inject.
scope: Direct (1:1) sessions at the receiving device. Inputs are what arrives from outside: inbox records, host responses, fetched bundles. Commands are the user's own and are not inputs here. Group conversations have their own authorization and sit under group-path. The completeness check maps every variant of the enums that carry these inputs to an entry, so a new variant does not compile until it is entered.

entries.input: An inbox record addressed to this device
A record that opened under one of the conversation's keys
An MLS application message and the protected payload inside it
entries.authenticatedBy: K(e), then the MLS epoch secrets and the sender's leaf

entries.input: An MLS commit from the peer
entries.authenticatedBy: K_c(e), MLS, and a detached signature under the committer's device key; it may refresh keys but not change the members

entries.input: An MLS proposal from the peer
entries.authenticatedBy: K(e) and MLS; only a member's self-update is kept, and only a commit applies it

entries.input: An MLS Welcome
A race loser's rebuild Welcome for a conversation this device holds
entries.authenticatedBy: K_c of the losing commit's base epoch, kept by the winner as the expected rebuild; exactly two leaves; the replaced session's commit keys are retained as fork witnesses

entries.input: The peer's Welcome while this device waits after losing its group
entries.reason: No session is left to authenticate the rebuild. The waiting state is entered only by a local MLS fault or a failed restore, and nothing remote can cause either; the recovery is trust on first use again.

entries.input: A Welcome that establishes a conversation
entries.authenticatedBy: the device key named by a root-pinned contact share
entries.reason: Establishment is not an interface of the ideal; it is trust on first use, checked against the key package the contact share names.

entries.input: A commit that contradicts a retained witness
entries.authenticatedBy: a retained K_c and a signature under the peer's device key; only a holder of that epoch's secrets can produce the frame

entries.input: A lane rotation carried in an application frame, with the peer's signed bundle
entries.authenticatedBy: the application frame's keys; the bundle it carries cannot add a device to the session

entries.input: A contact-accepted notice carried in an application frame
entries.authenticatedBy: the application frame's keys and the protected sender proof

entries.input: A contact-removed notice carried in an application frame
entries.authenticatedBy: the application frame's keys and the protected sender proof

entries.input: A group invitation carried in an application frame
Attachment ciphertext fetched from storage
entries.authenticatedBy: the attachment key and digest carried in an authenticated application frame

entries.input: A record none of the conversation's keys opens yet
entries.reason: A bounded buffer the host can fill; nothing in it applies until it opens under a session key.

entries.input: A record that fails authentication or arrives off the inbound address
entries.reason: Acked and dropped without a trace.

entries.input: A control message type
entries.reason: A direct frame's type is read from its MLS bytes, which yield only the four MLS types, so control types never arrive on the direct path.

entries.input: A fetched version of the peer's identity bundle
entries.authenticatedBy: the peer's root key, which a snapshot also holds
entries.reason: A change at the identity layer, confirmed out of band and outside the model. It cannot change an established session's members: one device per party.

entries.input: A failed identity fetch
entries.reason: Reported to the user; every session is kept.

entries.input: The host's history floor advancing past unread records
entries.reason: Moves the sync cursor and asks for recovery; no group is touched.

entries.input: A response to a request this device made
A failed request
entries.reason: Retry bookkeeping. An append failure may start an identity refresh, whose failure keeps the session.

entries.input: The inbox head
entries.reason: Schedules a fetch; changes no session state.

entries.input: The answer to an append
entries.reason: A constant; marks this device's own message delivered.

entries.input: The answer to an ack
entries.reason: Clears this device's own pending ack.

entries.input: A claimed KeyPackage of the peer
entries.authenticatedBy: the leaf key checked against the device key in the peer's bundle
entries.reason: Consumed only by a rebuild this device authorised itself (a lost race or its user's reset), and only for the accepted device.

entries.input: The count and replenishment of this device's own KeyPackage pool
entries.reason: Concerns this device's own published KeyPackages; no session state.

entries.input: First-contact requests listed or acted on by the host
entries.reason: Listing and triggering a sync; an accepted request's records go through inbox-record.

entries.input: The host's answer to this device registering or revoking its own lanes
entries.reason: Acknowledges this device's own act; no session state.

entries.input: The host's answer to this device publishing its shared state
entries.reason: Acknowledges this device's own publication; no session state.

entries.input: The app's lifecycle, timers, connections and the user's confirmations
entries.authenticatedBy: not an input from outside the device
entries.reason: Local events; what they start goes through the entries above.

entries.input: Group conversations: outbox, transitions, invites, joins, leaves, pickups
entries.authenticatedBy: group capabilities and the group's own MLS
entries.reason: Group conversations are outside the two-party model.
